text:
Type: low glass-door display cabinet
Use: displaying glassware, dishes, books and collections; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: white painted board, clear glass door panes, glass shelves, white bar handles
Colors: white, clear glass
Shape: compact boxy cabinet with two framed doors each split into two glass panes, slim vertical bar handles, inner glass shelves, recessed plinth base, light and tidy, medium visual weight
Feel: bright, clean, airy, practical
Goes with: light wood, white walls, grey or pastel textiles; Scandinavian or contemporary living and dining rooms
